title: Market, Limit, Stop Orders Explained: Price, Speed, or No Fill?
description:
One order book, one 10-unit buy, and a stop triggered at 99 while the next bid is 96. See how market, limit, post-only, stop-market, stop-limit, IOC, and FOK orders trade off execution speed, price limits, and the chance of no fill. The prices and quantities are illustrative; exchange rules and available liquidity vary. No order type guarantees a particular result.
